t: This is Alleyn's School in Dulwich, a day school and sixth form for children aged four to eighteen. It is a registered charity, and it began as part of Edward Alleyn's College of God's Gift, a foundation that also included James Allen's Girls' School and Dulwich College. Alleyn himself was an English actor and a major figure of the Elizabethan theatre. He founded the College of God's Gift in Dulwich, and the school you see today carries his name.
